verdict.rationale: Weave provides both a Service API (REST) and an official W&B MCP server that lets coding agents like Claude Code read live traces, evaluations, and run automated iteration loops on production data — directly matching the story. This is backed by first-party docs, a dedicated MCP server GitHub repo, and product marketing describing agents querying traces/evals/metrics via MCP. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on validation of the MCP server workflow in debugging scenarios.
